title: S285 Appendix D. Use of SDP for RTSP Session Descriptions

statements.subject: session
statements.description: SETUP requests may include this identifier in the If-Match field (see Section 18.24) to allow session establishment only if this attribute value still corresponds to that of the current description.
statements.guard_semantics: session establishment proceeds only when session_description.mtag = If-Match.value

statements.subject: session
statements.description: SETUP requests may include this identifier in the If-Match field to allow session establishment only if this attribute value still corresponds to that of the current description.
statements.trigger: SETUP request with If-Match header containing mtag value

statements.subject: client
statements.description: C->M: DESCRIBE rtsp://example.com/movie RTSP/2.0 ... M->C: RTSP/2.0 200 OK ... Content-Type: application/sdp
actions: server returns SDP in 200 OK response body

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The presence of a session-level control attribute MUST be interpreted as support for aggregated control.
statements.guard_semantics: session.aggregate_control_supported = true when session-level a=control is present

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Note that the position of the control URI in the description implies that the client establishes separate RTSP control sessions to the servers audio.example.com and video.example.com.
statements.trigger: SDP received with no session-level a=control attribute
actions: client establishes separate RTSP control sessions per media stream

statements.subject: client
statements.description: In this scenario, the server has multiple streams that can be controlled as a whole. In this case, there are both a media-level 'a=control' attribute ... and a session-level 'a=control' attribute ... the client is recommended to establish a single RTSP session to the server.
statements.trigger: SDP received with session-level a=control attribute
actions: client establishes single RTSP session for aggregate control
